verdict.rationale: Asana documents a step-by-step quick start guide that walks an engineer through first-time developer setup: creating and authorizing with a token, then creating tasks via the API. A developer sandbox (a temporary Asana domain) is also offered. However, nothing in the evidence describes a guided walkthrough for setting up the workspace itself, so the onboarding covers the developer's first app rather than the workspace. Missing for 10: a documented guided workspace-setup walkthrough or onboarding flow, guidance for configuring the developer sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the first-run experience.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can follow a guided walkthrough to set up my workspace the first time

citations.quote: Build your first app with our step by step quick start guide. Learn to create and authorize with a token then create tasks via the API.
A developer sandbox is a temporary Asana domain with limited users.
